issue: Discovery sweep found no new Benin LNG terminal meeting the add threshold. Both GEM Benin rows (Benin FSRU / TotalEnergies; Cotonou FSRU / Gasol+SOCAR T100000130246) remain cancelled with no revival. The only post-2024 forward signal is a regional Côte d'Ivoire–Benin–Togo World Bank-backed pooled-LNG-import framework (energy-ministers declaration, Abidjan 2025-12-07) — staged to monitor_list, not promotable yet (no host country/site/sponsor/operator for a Benin terminal; only a technical working group to be formed). Context for the next batch: if a Benin-sited FSRU with a sponsor emerges from this framework, it would be a new terminal rather than a revival of either cancelled project.
suggested_action: No action this batch. Watch the regional framework (monitor_list, re-check ~2026-12). Note that an FSRU under this framework could be sited in CIV or Togo rather than Benin.

terminal_name: Seme offshore oilfield (Benin) — Akrake / Petroleum Benin
issue: Search for Benin liquefaction/export surfaced the Seme offshore field redevelopment (Akrake Lime Petroleum / Petroleum Benin; first oil ~Jan 2026, Borr Gerd jack-up, Stella Energy 1 MOPU, Kristina FSO). This is OIL production, not gas liquefaction, and has no associated LNG terminal — out of scope, recorded so a future batch does not re-chase it as an LNG lead.
suggested_action: No action. Not an LNG terminal; do not add. Re-evaluate only if associated gas (gas-export or LNG) infrastructure is later announced for the field.
